// @molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/modules/images: public API snapshot.
// Generated by `node scripts/gates/api-snapshot.mjs --update`; do not edit by hand. A change below is a change to what plugins and other callers can use:
// say what it means for them in the PR.

export interface GeneratedImage {
    id: string;
    mime_type: "image/png" | "image/jpeg" | "image/webp";
    byte_length: number;
    filename: string;
}

export declare const IMAGES_PLUGIN_ID = "io.molis.work.images";

export declare const IMAGES_PROJECT_PLUGIN_ID = "images";

export type ImageApiFormat = "openai-images" | "gemini";

export interface ImageConnection {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    api_format: ImageApiFormat;
    base_url: string;
    model: string;
    has_key: boolean;
    available?: boolean;
    unavailable_reason?: string;
    auth_connection_id?: string;
    created_at: string;
    updated_at: string;
}

export interface ImageConnectionInput {
    id?: string;
    name: string;
    api_format: ImageApiFormat;
    base_url: string;
    model: string;
    auth_connection_id?: string;
}

export interface ImageGenerateInput {
    request_id: string;
    connection_id: string;
    prompt: string;
    size?: string;
    aspect_ratio?: string;
}

export interface ImageJob {
    id: string;
    project_id: string;
    request_id: string;
    connection_id: string;
    connection_name: string;
    api_format: ImageApiFormat;
    model: string;
    prompt: string;
    size: string;
    aspect_ratio: string;
    status: ImageJobStatus;
    images: GeneratedImage[];
    error: string;
    created_at: string;
    finished_at: string | null;
}

export type ImageJobStatus = "running" | "succeeded" | "failed" | "cancelled" | "interrupted";
